name: su2_poiseuille
title: SU2: the .su2 export checked end to end
headline: SU2 v8.6.0 reads every hexahedron and marker of the .su2; laminar Poiseuille Δp and u_max converge at order 2.02 to +0.26 %

references.source: Hagen–Poiseuille: $\Delta p = 32 \nu U_b \Delta x / D^2$, $u_{max} = 2 U_b$ at the realised bulk velocity

toolchain.conversion: write() to .su2, read by SU2_CFD (MESH_FORMAT= SU2)

format.version: SU2 native ASCII (NDIME 3, VTK cell types)

consumer.name: SU2
consumer.image: hexmesh-su2:8.6.0, built from validation/exports/su2/Dockerfile (ubuntu:24.04@sha256:008173c23f95b170204355c12626cb5a965d779a7e1283b09e9cffbb1bf33ca3; SU2_v8.6.0_linux64-omp.zip, sha256 b306dcb7e76caec54e376542916aae14a32abd6c2f6fa8b871ec10ffe80b41ac)

checks.import: SU2's hexahedra equal cell_count(), every boundary group a marker by name, every volume element correctly oriented, at each level (recheck); markers, cell types and counts on the written file (tests/test_export_formats.py)
checks.exact: laminar Poiseuille at Re 100: Δp between 15 D and 25 D, and u on the axis at 20 D, each within 2 % of Poiseuille at U_b at the finest level
checks.order: the errors' order over k = 1, 2, 3 reported (Richardson)
